snippet.title: Tamashika | Official Gameplay & Release Date Trailer
snippet.description:
Tamashika launches April 10, 2026 on PC, PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S, and Nintendo Switch.

A new look at the psychedelic FPS from developer quicktequila and publisher EDGLRD. Enter a shifting labyrinth where each day brings a new challenge. Armed with only a semi-auto pistol and tantō blade, players must blink, parry and shoot their way through procedurally generated corridors alive with traps and enemies.

Wishlist on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2996080/TAMASHIKA/

One gun, one blade. No loadouts, no excuses. Concentrate, pierce the illusion of chaos, and master the rhythm.

A dreamscape of rainbow psychedelia filled with colorful hand-drawn animations.

Roughly 300 pieces shuffle once per day to create a new labyrinth filled with twists, traps and enemies.

Find your flow state and climb the daily rankings.

Follow EDGLRD
https://edglrd.com
https://instagram.com/edglrd
https://x.com/edglrd
